functionalReqs: Riders and drivers register; drivers go online/offline and update location
Rider requests a ride (pickup, drop, vehicle type)
Match a nearby available driver; driver accepts or rejects
Trip lifecycle: requested → accepted → in progress → completed/cancelled
Fare by distance, time, vehicle type and surge; ratings
hints: Trip has a lifecycle with rules about which transitions are legal.
Matching and pricing vary: put them behind strategies. How are riders told about status changes?

RideService orchestrates; DriverMatchingStrategy (nearest, highest-rated); FareStrategy with SurgeDecorator; Trip with State (Requested, Accepted, InProgress, Completed, Cancelled); Observer notifies rider/driver; driver availability changed atomically (compareAndSet) during matching.
nonFunctionalReqs: A driver can't be assigned to two trips
Matching and pricing algorithms are swappable
problemStatement: Design the classes for a **ride-sharing** service: riders request rides, the system matches drivers, trips move through states, and fares are calculated with surge pricing.
title: Design a Ride-Sharing App (Uber LLD)
